purpose: State an intention about a future action.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
I intend to go to Japan next year.
I intend not to buy anything today.
I intend to keep studying after graduation.
restrictions: An intention is not a guarantee that the action will happen.
mistake: Use ないつもり for intending not to act; context distinguishes つもりはない.

segments.role: State an intention about a future action. Dictionary-form / ない-form + つもり.
